_comment: CANDIDATE registry for the DEDICATED_CAPSULE_V1 production-read worker. NOT deployed: the operator registry ~/.config/vidtoolz-resolve-control/registry.json stays qualification-only. Same shape as the operator registry (accepted-facade F-08 guard compatible). v1 has exactly one target: vidnux. PRESTO and VIDLAP2 cannot be production-read targets - the authority schema, the compiler and the worker all refuse any host but vidnux and any platform but Linux, so no remote_command is given for them. The worker runs INSIDE the approved capsule as uid 981; Hermes runs as the operator (uid 1000) and reaches it over loopback only.
_chain: Every PRODUCTION_READ start needs EIGHT bound artifacts: --secret-file (the shared HMAC key, operator-owned and capsule-readable, whose identity the accepted authority names), --production-authority (the ACCEPTED source record, re-verified at every operation), --production-policy + --production-policy-sha256 (the compiled policy FILE and its digest), --production-session + --production-session-sha256 (the sealed isolated session profile manifest and its digest) and --production-runtime-attestation + --production-runtime-attestation-sha256 (the record the in-capsule launcher wrote). Order: prepare_session_key.py -> compile_production_read_policy.py -> generate_session_profile.py -> verify_deployment_binding.py --pre-launch -> quit the normal Resolve -> vrc-capsule-launch (root broker) -> vrc_capsule_init.py (starts the CONFINED Resolve via launch_isolated_session.py, then the worker) -> verify_deployment_binding.py (full). End a session with tools/session_stop.py; never with a signal.
_host_primitive: The approved dedicated-capsule boundary (independent host review 2026-09-22, manifest 84f5bcbcf85e6cb7b1664b16ed1a715077a5e46c07da39c6f39304b4c6202de5): account vrc-capsule 981:981, broker /usr/local/libexec/vrc-capsule-launch, frozen runtime /usr/local/lib/vrc-capsule/resolve-runtime. The worker re-derives all of it at every operation; the registry is not authority for any of it.

vidnux._key_placement: python3 -B <candidate>/tools/prepare_session_key.py --out <secret_file>   # operator-owned 0640 + u:vrc-capsule:r ACL; prints the hmac_key_id for the authority record
vidnux._capsule_start: sudo /usr/local/libexec/vrc-capsule-launch   # root broker, zero arguments, clearenv, irreversible setuid(981); it starts capsule/vrc_capsule_init.py, which starts the CONFINED Resolve and then the worker
vidnux._local_start: python3 -B <candidate>/worker/resolve_worker.py --host-id vidnux --secret-file <secret> --state-dir <state> --mode PRODUCTION_READ --production-authority <AUTHORITY.json> --production-policy <policy.json> --production-policy-sha256 <POLICY_FILE_SHA256> --production-session <session-profile.json> --production-session-sha256 <SESSION_PROFILE_FILE_SHA256> --production-runtime-attestation <RUNTIME-ATTESTATION.json> --production-runtime-attestation-sha256 <RUNTIME_ATTESTATION_FILE_SHA256>   # started BY the capsule init, inside the capsule; never by hand on the host
vidnux._launcher: python3 -B <candidate>/tools/launch_isolated_session.py --authority <AUTHORITY.json> --policy <policy.json> --worker <candidate>/worker/resolve_worker.py --session <session-profile.json> --session-sha256 <SESSION_PROFILE_FILE_SHA256> --out <RUNTIME-ATTESTATION.json>   # ephemeral, runs INSIDE the capsule, once per session; NOT a service
vidnux._stop: python3 -B <candidate>/tools/session_stop.py --port 47021 --secret-file <secret>   # the ONLY way to end a session: an authenticated request, gated by the whole chain, that names no process
